nodes.dialogue_text: Bhishma's life wanes and his death is near. The battlefield pauses as Arjuna faces the choice that was written.
Shikhandi stands before me, and I will not raise my bow to him. Arjuna, strike. My body is a bed of your arrows, and my head hangs. Give it a pillow.

choices.choice_text: [Accept the canonical path. Lay the arrows beneath his head.]

nodes.dialogue_text: So the grandsire fell, and chose to wait for the sun's northward turn before he left his body.
